tweets.text:
"we just have to execute" is so problematic...

it conveys:
* plan is perfect
* the thinking has been done
* keep your head down, stay in your lane
* now it is about adherence to plan
* no time for new learning
* don't ask questions
* suspend disbelief/pushback

.. what is fascinating to me is that I have seen very well meaning people say this.

They just don't consider the message.

what they mean instead is:
* we need to focus
* make the right promises (and keep them)
* avoid shiny objects
* keep looking forward
* avoid decision drift

say it is really is a low complexity situation...

then:
"lets agree this is a low complexity situation"
"here's why speed is extremely important here..."
"we'll know very little until this thing is in the world, so we have to focus there..."

much better.
